name: New Day
overview: Scripture reveals that God initiates new beginnings, as seen in the creation of the heavens and the earth at the very start (Genesis 1:1). The promise of a new day brings hope and joy after sorrow, reflecting God's mercy and favor (Psalms 30:5). Believers are called to trust in the Lord’s timing and renewal, finding strength and perseverance as they wait on Him (Isaiah 40:31; Ecclesiastes 3:11). This newness also involves leaving behind past failures and focusing on the future God has ordained (Isaiah 43:18), all while dwelling securely under His protection (Psalms 91:1).
